options.name: SYSTEM
options.description: Defines the system authentication mechanism for the user.

options.name: account_locked
options.description: Indicates if the user account is locked.

options.name: admgroups
options.description: Lists the groups the user administrates.

options.name: admin
options.description: Defines the administrative status of the user.

options.name: auditclasses
options.description: Lists the user's audit classes.

options.name: auth1
options.description: Lists additional mandatory methods for authenticating the user. The auth1 attribute has been deprecated and may not be supported in a future release. The SYSTEM attribute should be used instead. The authentication process will fail if any of the methods specified by the auth1 attribute fail.

options.name: auth2
options.description: Lists additional optional methods for authenticating the user. The auth2 attribute has been deprecated and may not be supported in a future release. The SYSTEM attribute should be used instead. The authentication process will not fail if any of the methods specified by the auth2 attribute fail.

options.name: core_compress
options.description: Enables or disables core file compression. If this attribute has a value of C(On), compression is enabled; otherwise, compression is disabled.

options.name: core_naming
options.description: Selects a choice of core file naming strategies. A value of C(On) enables core file naming in the form core.pid.time

options.name: core_path
options.description: Enables or disables core file path specification. If this attribute has a value of C(On), core files will be placed in the directory specified by core_pathname (the feature is enabled); If set to C(Off), core files are placed in the user's current working directory.

options.name: core_pathname
options.description: Specifies a location to be used to place core files, if the core_path attribute is set to C(On). If this is not set and I(core_path=On), core files will be placed in the user's current working directory. This attribute is limited to 256 characters.

options.name: daemon
options.description: Indicates whether the user specified by the Name parameter can execute programs using the cron daemon or the src (system resource controller) daemon.

options.name: dce_export
options.description: Allows the DCE registry to overwrite the local user information with the DCE user information during a DCE export operation.

options.name: dictionlist
options.description: Defines the password dictionaries used by the composition restrictions when checking new passwords.

options.name: efs_adminks_access
options.description: Defines the efs_admin keystore location. This attribute is valid only if the system is EFS-enabled.

options.name: efs_allowksmodechangebyuser
options.description: Defines whether the user can change the mode or not. This attribute is valid only if the system is EFS-enabled.

options.name: efs_file_algo
options.description: Defines the algorithm that is used to generate the file protection key. This attribute is valid only if the system is EFS-enabled.

options.name: efs_initialks_mode
options.description: Defines the initial mode of the user keystore. This attribute is valid only if the system is EFS-enabled.

options.name: efs_keystore_access
options.description: Defines the user keystore location. This attribute is valid only if the system is EFS-enabled.

options.name: efs_keystore_algo
options.description: Defines the user keystore location. This attribute is valid only if the system is EFS-enabled.

options.name: expires
options.description: Identifies the expiration date of the account. The Value parameter is a 10-character string in the MMDDhhmmyy form, where MM = month, DD = day, hh = hour, mm = minute, and yy = last 2 digits of the years 1939 through 2038.

options.name: histexpire
options.description: Designates the period of time (in weeks) that a user cannot reuse a password.

options.name: histsize
options.description: Designates the number of previous passwords a user cannot reuse.

options.name: login
options.description: Indicates whether the user can log in to the system with the login command.

options.name: loginretries
options.description: Defines the number of unsuccessful login attempts allowed after the last successful login before the system locks the account.

options.name: logintimes
options.description: Specifies the times, days, or both, the user is allowed to access the system. The day variable must be one digit between 0 and 6 that represents one of the days of the week. A 0 (zero) indicates Sunday and a 6 indicates Saturday. The time variable is 24-hour military time (1700 is 5:00 p.m.). Leading zeroes are required. For example, you must enter 0800, not 800. The date variable is a four digit string in the form mmdd. mm represents the calendar month and dd represents the day number. Entries

options.name: maxage
options.description: Defines the maximum age (in weeks) of a password.

options.name: maxexpired
options.description: Defines the maximum time (in weeks) beyond the maxage value that a user can change an expired password.

options.name: maxrepeats
options.description: Defines the maximum number of times a character can be repeated in a new password.

options.name: minage
options.description: Defines the minimum age (in weeks) a password must be before it can be changed.

options.name: minalpha
options.description: Defines the minimum number of alphabetic characters that must be in a new password.

options.name: mindiff
options.description: Defines the minimum number of characters required in a new password that were not in the old password.

options.name: mindigit
options.description: Defines the minimum number of digits that must be in a new password.

options.name: minlen
options.description: Defines the minimum length of a password.

options.name: minloweralpha
options.description: Defines the minimum number of lower case alphabetic characters that must be in a new password.

options.name: minother
options.description: Defines the minimum number of non-alphabetic characters that must be in a new password.

options.name: minspecialchar
options.description: Defines the minimum number of special characters that must be in a new password.

options.name: minupperalpha
options.description: Defines the minimum number of upper case alphabetic characters that must be in a new password.

options.name: projects
options.description: Defines the list of projects that the user's processes can be assigned to.

options.name: pwdchecks
options.description: Defines the password restriction methods enforced on new passwords.

options.name: pwdwarntime
options.description: Defines the number of days before the system issues a warning that a password change is required.

options.name: registry
options.description: Defines the authentication registry where the user is administered.

options.name: rlogin
options.description: Permits access to the account from a remote location with the telnet or rlogin commands.

options.name: stanza
options.description: Name of stanza to modify attributes of

options.name: state
options.description: If set to C(present) all given attrs values will be set. If set to C(absent) all attrs provided will be un-set, regardless of value provided. NB, this does not remove the entire stanza, only the provided attrs will be removed. To remove a single attribute from the stanza set to C(present) and set key to an empty value (key=). All rules/allowed file-stanza combos/allowed files for the AIX C(chsec) command apply here.

options.name: su
options.description: Indicates whether another user can switch to the specified user account with the su command.

options.name: sugroups
options.description: Lists the groups that can use the su command to switch to the specified user account.

options.name: tpath
options.description: Indicates the user's trusted path status.

options.name: ttys
options.description: Lists the terminals that can access the account specified by the Name parameter.

options.name: umask
options.description: Determines file permissions. This value, along with the permissions of the creating process determines a file's permissions when the file is created.
